fsm_states_link_initialization.name: OFFLINE
fsm_states_link_initialization.description: Link not operational; the port transmits OLS (Offline) primitive sequence.

fsm_states_link_initialization.name: NOS_RECEIVED
fsm_states_link_initialization.description: A not-operational partner is transmitting NOS (Not Operational); begin the primitive-sequence handshake.

fsm_states_link_initialization.name: LINK_RESET_RESPONSE
fsm_states_link_initialization.description: Partner responds with LRR (Link Reset Response).

fsm_states_link_initialization.name: ACTIVE
fsm_states_link_initialization.description: Both ends operational; IDLEs exchanged; frames may flow.

fsm_states_link_initialization.name: LOOP_INIT (LIP)
fsm_states_link_initialization.description: FC-AL only: loop initialization resets the loop and assigns 8-bit AL_PAs.

fsm_states_login.name: LOGGED_OUT
fsm_states_login.description: No fabric/port login; only link-level primitives.

fsm_states_login.name: FLOGI_SENT
fsm_states_login.description: Fabric login request sent to 0xFFFFFE; awaiting the assigned 24-bit address + service parameters.

fsm_states_login.name: FABRIC_LOGGED_IN
fsm_states_login.description: FLOGI accepted; the port holds its 24-bit FC address.

fsm_states_login.name: PLOGI_SENT
fsm_states_login.description: Port login to a peer N_Port or Name Server; exchanging WWN/EE_Credit/classes.

fsm_states_login.name: PROCESS_LOGGED_IN
fsm_states_login.description: PRLI accepted; FC-4 (FCP) session established with negotiated initiator/target roles.

fsm_states_loop_arbitration.name: MONITORING
fsm_states_loop_arbitration.description: NL_Port watches the loop for ARB and OPN.

fsm_states_loop_arbitration.name: ARBITRATING
fsm_states_loop_arbitration.description: Transmits ARB(AL_PA) to win loop access.

fsm_states_loop_arbitration.name: OPEN
fsm_states_loop_arbitration.description: Won arbitration; sends OPN to a destination AL_PA and opens a loop connection.

fsm_states_loop_arbitration.name: TRANSFER
fsm_states_loop_arbitration.description: Frames flow on the open loop connection.

fsm_states_loop_arbitration.name: CLOSE
fsm_states_loop_arbitration.description: Sends CLS to close the loop connection and release the loop.

fsm_states_sequence_exchange.name: EXCHANGE_OPEN
fsm_states_sequence_exchange.description: Originator allocates OX_ID and starts the first sequence.

fsm_states_sequence_exchange.name: SEQUENCE_ACTIVE
fsm_states_sequence_exchange.description: Frames of the current sequence (same SEQ_ID) flow, ordered by SEQ_CNT.

fsm_states_sequence_exchange.name: SEQUENCE_INITIATIVE_TRANSFER
fsm_states_sequence_exchange.description: F_CTL passes sequence initiative to the other side.

fsm_states_sequence_exchange.name: EXCHANGE_CLOSE
fsm_states_sequence_exchange.description: Last sequence completes; exchange closed (OX_ID/RX_ID freed).

fsm_states_sequence_exchange.name: ABORT (ABTS)
fsm_states_sequence_exchange.description: On error, the originator issues ABTS to abort the sequence/exchange.

fsm_hints.trigger: On power-up a port runs the primitive-sequence link-init (OLS/NOS -> LR -> LRR -> ACTIVE), then logs in (FLOGI to the fabric for a 24-bit address, PLOGI to peers, PRLI for FC-4). On FC-AL it first runs LIP loop initialization and AL_PA assignment.
fsm_hints.rule: Each frame carries SEQ_ID/SEQ_CNT and OX_ID/RX_ID; the sequence is the unit of recovery; sequence initiative is held by one side at a time (F_CTL).
fsm_hints.abort: A CRC error / lost frame aborts the sequence; the originator issues ABTS; persistent link failure drops to the primitive-sequence protocol to re-initialize.

anti_deadlock_rule: Credit-based flow control (BB_Credit per link via R_RDY, EE_Credit end-to-end via ACK) bounds outstanding frames so a slow receiver cannot overflow; the transmitter blocks on zero credit rather than dropping frames. Loop arbitration (ARB / access fairness) prevents a single NL_Port from monopolizing the loop.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: Reset/power-up -> OFFLINE (transmit OLS) -> primitive-sequence handshake (NOS/OLS -> LR -> LRR) -> ACTIVE (exchange IDLEs) -> FLOGI (fabric, acquire 24-bit address) -> PLOGI/PRLI (sessions). On FC-AL, LIP loop initialization and AL_PA assignment precede login.

configurations.name: Point-to-point
configurations.description: Two N_Ports, no fabric; FLOGI not used (or rejected); direct parameter negotiation.

configurations.name: Arbitrated loop (FC-AL)
configurations.description: Up to 126 NL_Ports share the loop with ARB-based arbitration and 8-bit AL_PAs.

configurations.name: Switched fabric
configurations.description: N_Ports attach to F_Ports on switches that route by 24-bit address; E_Ports link switches.

timing_dependency_rule: FC-0/FC-1 are embedded-clock (receiver CDR), so each direction self-clocks from the encoded stream; word synchronization aligns on the K28.5 comma. FC-2 framing, sequence/exchange tracking, credit accounting, and the login/exchange FSMs run in the controller clock domain decoupled from the line rate.
